capabilities.text: Pick one of six real reversible reactions
capabilities.note: ours has no list of reactions: the teacher types the species, coefficients and phases (all six render correctly that way, ions included), and no reaction carries its own ΔH

capabilities.text: Use a made-up reaction A + B ⇌ C
capabilities.note: typed into ours' general aA + bB ⇌ cC + dD

capabilities.text: Make the forward reaction exothermic or endothermic
capabilities.note: ours types ΔH on each temperature stress, not on the reaction

capabilities.text: Type each species' starting concentration in mol/L, starting from reactants, products or a mixture
capabilities.note: also drag handles on each starting concentration

capabilities.text: Type K
Set the time at which equilibrium is first reached
Add or remove a species as a stress, at a time you type
capabilities.evidence: changes:dist=Add a species + changes:dist=Remove a species + changes:{"dist":"Add a species","dist_time":4.0}

capabilities.text: Change the volume as a stress
Raise or lower the temperature as a stress
capabilities.evidence: changes:dist=Change the temperature + changes:{"dist":"Change the temperature","dist_t2":250.0}

capabilities.text: Apply up to three stresses on one graph
Write the page's own words over each stress line, your own words, or nothing
capabilities.note: ours always writes its own words over the stress line

capabilities.text: Write each line's formula beside it, or hide the formulas
capabilities.note: ours always writes the formula and its value beside each line

capabilities.text: Draw the lines in color, or in black told apart as solid, dashed and dotted
Give the chart a title as text, a blank line, or none
Give each axis title as text, a blank line, or none
Type each axis's range and count-by, with a button to fit them to the graph
capabilities.note: axes are always fitted; no typed range

capabilities.text: Number every line, every 2nd, 5th or 10th line, or no lines on each axis
Add minor gridlines, 2, 4 or 5 per block
Choose the label size
Write a label at the far end of each axis, as your own text or none
Finish each end of each axis plainly or with an arrowhead
